payload.name: slice
payload.description: Load a space for this turn as a slice: nodes, edges, axes, and the proposals still waiting as ghosts. Your own space whole; the operator’s through its blessed sources and what he has blessed across.

query.description: Keep only nodes whose text mentions this.

space.description: The space to read: your own, or the operator’s through what he has blessed.

topK.description: Keep at most this many, newest first.

payload.name: reflect
payload.description: Record what this session noticed, in the shape the next session can retrieve. Lands in your own space at once; a proposal to carry it into the operator’s memory waits for blessing.

attempted.description: What this session set out to do, in one sentence.

cites.description: The nodes you read, by space and id, with the span if it matters.

inferred.description: What you concluded from the observations. Kept apart from them.

observed.description: What actually happened. Facts a later session can rely on, one per entry.

shouldChange.description: What a prompt, skill, verb, or policy should do differently, and why.

payload.name: recall
payload.description: Ask your memory a question. Resonance ranks the reflections nearest it; those are compiled into claims and events with their times and quantities, conflicts between them are named, and the compile answers as far as it can. Without a compiler wired, it says so.

payload.name: pending
payload.description: The proposals still waiting in a space: what has been offered and not yet answered.

space.description: The space whose gap to count.

payload.name: sync
payload.description: Report the drift between each sibling repository’s pinned commit and its remote. No pin moves; advancing one is a pull request.
